name: Customer Story Card
Primary CTA Button
role: Main call-to-action, 'Get started for free', 'Sign up'
description: backgroundColor #007afc, color #ffffff, borderRadius 100px, padding 12px 24px. No border visible (border matches background). The only filled blue element on the page — stands alone against the black field.

name: Outlined Pill Button
role: Secondary actions like 'Contact us', nav secondary links
description: backgroundColor transparent, color #ffffff, border 1px solid #bbc2ce, borderRadius 100px, padding 12px 24px. On hover, likely shifts border to #ffffff. Maintains pill geometry to match primary CTA.

name: Ghost Text Button
role: Inline text links, 'Learn more →', 'Read more →', footer links
description: backgroundColor transparent, color #ffffff or #007afc for links, borderRadius 0px, no padding. Used for narrative-flow links where a button frame would over-formalize the action.

name: Icon Frame Button
role: Utility buttons like language selector 'EN', compact controls
description: backgroundColor transparent, color #ffffff, border 1px solid #444d5a, borderRadius 6px, padding 8px 10px. Sharp radius breaks from the pill system — signals 'tool', not 'action'.

name: Product Update Badge
role: Labels marking new features, product announcements
description: backgroundColor #228a56, color #ffffff, borderRadius 4px, padding 5.6px 7.7px. All-caps Cera Pro at 10px with +1.00em letter-spacing. Green signals 'new/live', echoing map layer status indicators.

name: Info Badge
description: backgroundColor #0062ca, color #ffffff, borderRadius 3px, padding 3px 6px. Slightly tighter radius and padding than Product Update badge — distinguishes tier.

name: Category Tab / Filter Pill
description: Active state: backgroundColor #007afc, color #ffffff, borderRadius 100px. Inactive: backgroundColor transparent, color #a0aaba, borderRadius 100px with visible border. Cera Pro 500 at 15–16px.

name: News / Product Carousel Card
role: Homepage feature cards for recent updates and partnerships
description: borderRadius 24px, dark surface #15171b, badge at top-left, headline Cera Pro 700, directional arrow link in #007afc. Card edges use inset shadow rgb(14,16,18) to bleed into page background.

name: Logo Grid (Social Proof Rail)
role: Partner/customer logo display — GM, CNN, BMW, Strava etc.
description: Logos rendered in #a0aaba (desaturated) against #0e1012 background. No card frames. Two rows, roughly 6 logos per row. Tight letter-spaced all-caps Cera Pro label above in #566171 at 12px.

name: Top Navigation Bar
role: Sticky site nav with logo, dropdown menus, CTA
description: backgroundColor #0e1012, height 62px, boxShadow rgb(14,16,18) 0px 0px 100px 50px on scroll. Left: Mapbox wordmark in #ffffff. Center: dropdown nav links in Cera Pro 400/500 at 15px color #ffffff. Right: 'Log in' ghost text + 'Sign up' primary pill (#007afc).

name: Video / Map Embed Block
role: Full-width media with inset shadow fade at bottom edge
description: borderRadius 24px, inset shadow rgb(14,16,18) 0px -175px 175px -75px at bottom — the map tile or video appears to dissolve into the page background. Plays on the 'emerging from darkness' surface philosophy.
